name: The Competitive Ledger
description: An original, fictional North American esports-business publication known for its critical coverage of private-capital investment in competitive gaming, edited by Nathaniel Price.
notes: Entirely original to the Kairos Universe; no real-world publication of this name is referenced or implied.
Previously published seven articles critical of Asterion Intelligence's and Kairos's financial scale before interviewing Adrian Vale directly in Episode 102.
